title: RSC Boundary Plan
description: A structured 'use client' boundary decision for one component change in an RSC app, so leaf-pushing, slot composition, serialization, and environment-poisoning rules can be checked deterministically by scripts/react_server_components_boundary_audit.mjs.

componentRole.description: What the component is in the tree. Layouts/pages should almost never be the client boundary.

usesHooksOrBrowserApis.description: True if the component uses hooks, event handlers, or browser APIs (window, localStorage).

markedUseClient.description: True if the component's module carries the 'use client' directive.

interactiveBitExtractable.description: True if the interactive portion could be split into a smaller leaf component (leaf-pushing applies).

serverChildrenNeeded.description: True if Server Components (data fetching, secrets) must render inside this component.

usesChildrenSlot.description: True if Server children arrive via the children/JSX-prop slot pattern rather than direct imports.

crossingProps.description: The kinds of props crossing from Server to Client. function / class-instance / null-prototype-object / unregistered-symbol cannot cross.

importsServerOnlyModules.description: True if the module graph pulls in data-layer or secret-reading modules (DB client, process.env.API_KEY readers).

serverOnlyGuardUsed.description: True if server-only (and client-only where relevant) package guards harden the seam at build time.

providerWrapsHtml.description: True if a context provider wraps the <html> document instead of {children}. Must be false.

usesThirdPartyHookLib.description: True if the component renders a third-party library that uses hooks but may not ship 'use client'.

thirdPartyHookLibWrapped.description: True if such a library is re-exported through a local one-line 'use client' wrapper file.

bundleSizeChecked.description: True if the next build route table (First Load JS) was diffed before and after the change.
